A closer look

THE SPARK

Why this one?

The ocean is difficult to communicate through, especially when machinery and vessels interfere with sound. I wanted to investigate what machine learning could learn from those signals.

THE BUILD

How it works

As part of an Advanced Academic Centre project, I am building towards an underwater acoustic routing system. Recorded audio is converted into STFT spectrograms for CNN-based interference analysis, with the longer-term goal of helping pick more reliable acoustic communication paths.

Python · Librosa · NumPy · STFT · TensorFlow / Keras

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • Wolfset dataset exploration and preprocessing
  • Spectrogram generation and CNN classification
  • Future noise mapping and routing research
